entries.name: Better Vanilla Perks
entries.summary: Reworks skill perks. Two Friend Kit patches change some of them.
entries.detail: Our revision 7 perk overhaul adds weapon, armor, crafting and magic bonuses. The patches remove slowed time, extra summon slots and torch unlocking, add the Archery choices, and lock Necromage and Dark Souls 2. Not tested with a full party yet.

entries.name: Mysticism
entries.summary: Rebalances old spells and adds new ones; use the main package only.
entries.detail: Better Vanilla Perks changes some spells and summon strength. Part of revision 7. Mark, Recall and corpse raising stay quarantined (don't use yet); one active summon each. Optional addons are outside our setup.

entries.name: Imperious — Races of Skyrim
entries.summary: Gives each race distinct abilities and an unlockable power; four powers stay quarantined (don't use yet).
entries.detail: Part of revision 7. Quarantined (don't use yet): Contingency, Red Sand Dance, Beast Tongue and Spirit Walk. NPCs gain racial abilities too; co-op effects and unlocks are untested.

entries.name: Strong Reflexes rank 1 — Better Vanilla Perks
entries.summary: Halve power-attack damage while blocking with a shield.
entries.detail: The Block 30 rank protects you without slowing time. Rank 2 at Block 50 is allowed too.

entries.name: Strong Reflexes rank 2 — Better Vanilla Perks
entries.summary: Halves all damage while you block. Our perk patch removes the time slowdown Better Vanilla Perks adds.
entries.detail: The Block 50 rank. Changed for co-op by the held-perk patch.

entries.name: Steady Hand rank 1 — Better Vanilla Perks
entries.summary: Adds 10% bow critical chance and 5% more bow damage. No time slowdown in our game.
entries.detail: The Archery 40 rank. Take Steady Hand or Quick Draw, not both (Quiet Hunter patch).

entries.name: Steady Hand rank 2 — Better Vanilla Perks
entries.summary: Adds critical chance and protection against disarming. Our patches do not change it.
entries.detail: The Archery 60 rank. It needs rank 1, so it follows the Steady Hand choice.

entries.name: Dark Souls 2 — Better Vanilla Perks
entries.summary: Reanimated bodies can explode when combat starts.
entries.detail: Locked by our perk patch: it shows greyed out. Raising corpses is also quarantined.

entries.name: Dragonborn rank 4 (Speech 60) — Better Vanilla Perks
entries.summary: Buying and selling prices are 25% better. Our perk patch removes the spectral drum.
entries.detail: The price bonus is the whole perk in our game.

entries.name: Dragonborn rank 5 (Speech 80) — Better Vanilla Perks
entries.summary: Buying and selling prices are 30% better. Our perk patch removes the Dremora Merchant.
entries.detail: The price bonus is the whole perk in our game.

entries.name: Manual lockpicking
entries.summary: Open locks with lockpicks.
entries.detail: Opened locks synchronize. Our perk patch removes Better Vanilla Perks' torch unlock, so you pick every lock by hand.

entries.name: More than one active summon per player
entries.summary: Keep one active summon per player. Our perk patch removes the extra slots Better Vanilla Perks adds.
entries.detail: Corpse raising, Beast Tongue and Spirit Walk stay excluded.

entries.name: Summoner — Better Vanilla Perks
entries.summary: Summoning spells can be cast twice as far away. It adds no summon slot in our game; keep one active summon.
entries.detail: The held-perk patch removes the extra slot.

entries.name: Puppeteer — Better Vanilla Perks
entries.summary: Summoning spells can be cast three times as far away. It adds no summon slot in our game; keep one active summon.
entries.detail: The held-perk patch removes the extra slot.

entries.name: Twin Souls — Better Vanilla Perks
entries.summary: Conjuration spells cost 10% less magicka. It adds no summon slots in our game; keep one active summon.
entries.detail: The held-perk patch replaces the two extra summons with a cheaper-spell bonus.

entries.name: Dragonborn rank 2 — Better Vanilla Perks
entries.summary: Buying and selling prices are 15% better. It adds no summon in our game; keep one active summon.
entries.detail: The Speech 20 rank no longer lets you command an extra follower: the held-perk patch removes that.

entries.name: Resurgence — Better Vanilla Perks
entries.summary: Restoration spells cost 10% less magicka in our game.
entries.detail: The held-perk patch replaces Better Vanilla Perks' 30% Restoration strength bonus. It only lowers your own spell cost.

entries.name: Staff of the Atronach — Better Vanilla Perks
entries.summary: An atronach is a summoned elemental spirit.
entries.detail: Strengthens certain staff spells and summons. Potent atronachs and thralls use Better Vanilla Perks' level scaling. One active summon.

entries.name: Red Sand Dance — Imperious
entries.summary: The Redguard power slows time while sprinting.
entries.detail: Its 45-second trance slows time by 90% during sprints. Do not activate this power in our campaign.

entries.name: Contingency — Imperious
entries.summary: The High Elf power automatically casts stored spells.
entries.detail: You choose a trigger and store equipped spells for free automatic casting. Do not use this power in our campaign.

entries.name: Beast Tongue — Imperious
entries.summary: The Wood Elf power recruits an animal companion.
entries.detail: It befriends the nearest carnivorous animal and allows one animal companion. Do not use this power in our campaign.

entries.name: Spirit Walk — Imperious
entries.summary: The Dark Elf power summons two invulnerable ancestors.
entries.detail: It spends two Spirit Favor for 45 seconds of ancestral help. Our ordinary summon allowance does not clear this power.

entries.name: Discipline — Imperious
entries.summary: Boosts nearby allies' armor and attacks; do not rely on it protecting players.
entries.detail: During armed combat, nearby allies gain armor and attack damage. Its effect on human players is not verified; it does not heal.

entries.name: Harrier — Imperious
entries.summary: Marks prey for loot and weakens foes; do not rely on a party-wide bonus.
entries.detail: The bird points out animals or enemies, reducing enemy armor and magic resistance. Benefits for friends and quest progress are not verified.

entries.name: Whispers — Imperious
entries.summary: Ancestors mark enemies for gold and Spirit Favor.
entries.detail: Slay marked humanoids to earn the reward. Personal progress is not tested in co-op yet; Spirit Walk remains quarantined (don't use yet).

entries.name: Prowl — Imperious
entries.summary: Quieter sneaking and a powerful leap.
entries.detail: Leap while sneaking with weapons sheathed, spending Stamina. It is movement, not teleportation. Not tested in co-op yet; stay with the party.

entries.name: Shared Ancestry — Imperious
entries.summary: Borrow a human or elf's racial power; all existing quarantines still apply.
entries.detail: The Breton power borrows a living target's racial power for five minutes. Never use it to bypass quarantined powers. Not tested in co-op yet.

entries.name: Mark — Mysticism
entries.summary: Saves a place for Recall.
entries.detail: An Expert Conjuration spell. Do not mark travel destinations in this campaign until the group clears Mark and Recall.

entries.name: Recall — Mysticism
entries.summary: Teleports you to your marked location.
entries.detail: An Expert Conjuration spell. Do not use this travel shortcut in our campaign until the group clears Mark and Recall.

entries.name: Corpse reanimation
entries.summary: Raising an existing corpse makes it fight for you.
entries.detail: Includes Raise Zombie, Reanimate Corpse, Revenant, Dread Zombie and Dead Thrall, plus corpse-raising staves and scrolls. Ordinary conjured helpers still have the one-summon limit.

entries.name: Conjure Skeleton — Mysticism
entries.summary: Summons a basic skeleton; keep one active summon.
entries.detail: Novice Conjuration. Creates a helper without using a corpse. Corpse raising remains quarantined (don't use yet).

entries.name: Conjure Skeleton Warrior — Mysticism
entries.summary: Summons a skeleton warrior; keep one active summon.
entries.detail: Expert Conjuration. Creates a helper without using a corpse. Corpse raising remains quarantined (don't use yet).

entries.name: Conjure Skeleton Archer — Mysticism
entries.summary: Summons a skeleton archer; keep one active summon.
entries.detail: Apprentice Conjuration. Brings a ranged helper without raising a corpse.

entries.name: Conjure Skeleton Mage — Mysticism
entries.summary: Summons a skeleton mage; keep one active summon.
entries.detail: Adept Conjuration. Brings a magical helper without raising a corpse.

entries.name: Conjure Skeleton Champion — Mysticism
entries.summary: Summons a skeleton champion; keep one active summon.
entries.detail: Master Conjuration. Creates a powerful skeleton without raising a corpse.

entries.name: Conjure Wrathman Marksman — Mysticism
entries.summary: Summons an undead archer; keep one active summon if obtained normally.
entries.detail: In our game files; getting it normally is (not verified). The public list omits it. Separate from Conjure Wrathman.

entries.name: Ordinary creature summons
entries.summary: Summon a creature to fight beside you; keep one active summon.
entries.detail: Conjure Familiar keeps Mysticism's spell and wolf. Better Vanilla Perks supplies its text and look. Corpse raising and quarantined racial summons remain excluded.

entries.name: Healing Hands — Mysticism
entries.summary: Hold the cast to keep healing your target.
entries.detail: Apprentice Restoration. Aim at a living ally and keep casting. Player healing amounts, experience and perk bonuses are not tested in co-op yet.

entries.name: Heal Other — Mysticism
entries.summary: Send a burst of healing to your target.
entries.detail: Apprentice Restoration in Mysticism, earlier than vanilla's Adept version. Aim at a living ally.

entries.name: Grand Healing — Mysticism
entries.summary: Keep casting to heal yourself and nearby allies.
entries.detail: Expert Restoration. Mysticism changes the vanilla burst into continuous healing while you cast. It is not a starter spell; not tested in co-op yet.

entries.name: Ordinary self-healing spells
entries.summary: Restore your own Health with healing spells.
entries.detail: Healing and Fast Healing are continuous casts in Mysticism; Close Wounds gives a burst. These do not resurrect players.

entries.name: Courage
entries.summary: Temporarily increases nearby living allies' Health, Magicka and Stamina.
entries.detail: Novice Illusion in Mysticism. Skyrim Together supports this buff on players, but exact results with our mods are not tested in co-op yet.

entries.name: Rally
entries.summary: A stronger boost to nearby living allies' Health, Magicka and Stamina.
entries.detail: Adept Illusion in Mysticism. Skyrim Together supports this buff on players, but exact results with our mods are not tested in co-op yet.

entries.name: Call to Arms
entries.summary: The strongest of these nearby-ally attribute buffs.
entries.detail: Master Illusion in Mysticism. Increases allies' Health, Magicka and Stamina. Skyrim Together supports player targeting; exact results are not tested in co-op yet.

entries.name: Vampiric Touch — Mysticism
entries.summary: Steal Health from a living enemy within melee range.
entries.detail: Adept Destruction. The absorbed Health heals you. It does not require raising a corpse.

entries.name: Vampiric Bolt — Mysticism
entries.summary: Fire a bolt that steals Health from a living enemy.
entries.detail: Adept Destruction. A ranged drain spell that heals you as it harms its target.

entries.name: Blood Lance — Mysticism
entries.summary: Steal Health from living enemies in an area.
entries.detail: Master Destruction, sold by special vendors. A later blood-mage option; its exact damage and healing are not tested in co-op yet.

entries.name: Direct fire, frost and shock spells
entries.summary: Attack with fire, frost or shock.
entries.detail: Flames, Frostbite and Sparks keep Mysticism's extra effects. Flames damages and burns; Intense Flames can cause fear. Frostbite drains health and stamina, slows, and can freeze. Sparks damages; Disintegrate can trigger. Avoid friendly NPCs.

entries.name: Calm, Fear and Frenzy on enemies
entries.summary: Allowed on enemies: stop fights, frighten targets or turn them against each other.
entries.detail: Target eligible NPCs; these spells cannot control human players. Mysticism changes names and level limits.

entries.name: Daedric Cure and Oblivion's Embrace — Mysticism
entries.summary: Heal nearby summoned helpers; use on your one allowed summon.
entries.detail: Daedric Cure and Oblivion's Embrace heal summons. Player healing is (not verified); use ordinary Restoration for friends. Corpse raising stays quarantined (don't use yet).
aliases: Conjurer's Cure and other undead-healing effects

entries.name: Ghostwalk — Mysticism
entries.summary: Invisibility returns after you break it.
entries.detail: Master Illusion. The current changelog says invisibility refreshes after roughly three seconds. It does not teleport you.

entries.name: Close Greater Wounds — Mysticism
entries.summary: Burst healing for yourself and nearby living allies.
entries.detail: Adept Restoration. An earlier area-healing option than Grand Healing. Its effect on friends is not tested in co-op yet.

entries.name: Breath of Life — Mysticism
entries.summary: A stronger burst of healing for yourself and nearby allies.
entries.detail: Expert Restoration. A single cast heals nearby living allies; it does not revive dead players.

entries.name: Stendarr's Mercy — Mysticism
entries.summary: A powerful burst of healing for yourself and nearby allies.
entries.detail: Master Restoration. A late healing option for living allies nearby. It does not resurrect players.

entries.name: Sunbeam — Mysticism
entries.summary: Channel sunlight to damage undead.
entries.detail: Novice Restoration. Keep casting to burn an undead target. A starting anti-undead option; not tested in co-op yet.

entries.name: Circle of Life — Mysticism
entries.summary: Place a circle that restores Health inside it.
entries.detail: Adept Restoration. Try it as a healing spot; healing other players inside the circle is (not verified).

entries.name: Night Eye — Mysticism
entries.summary: See more clearly in the dark.
entries.detail: Apprentice Illusion. Any race can learn this spell. Vanilla already gives night vision to Khajiit and vampires.

entries.name: Conjure Wrathman — Mysticism
entries.summary: Summons a Wrathman to fight beside you; keep one active summon.
entries.detail: Master Conjuration. Its tome is found in the Soul Cairn. Summons a helper without raising a corpse.

entries.name: Necromage — Better Vanilla Perks
entries.summary: The Restoration 70 perk. Locked by our perk patch, so it shows greyed out.
entries.detail: It needs Resurgence and gives a 30% bonus against undead. Taking Resurgence does not unlock it.
